name: audio-tts
description: Desktop TTS app using Qwen3-TTS for voice design and cloning

scripts.start: bun run build && bun run dev
scripts.push:canary: npm version prerelease --preid=canary && git push origin main --tags
scripts.push:patch: npm version prepatch --preid=canary && git push origin main --tags
scripts.push:minor: npm version preminor --preid=canary && git push origin main --tags
scripts.push:major: npm version premajor --preid=canary && git push origin main --tags
scripts.push:stable: npm version patch && git push origin main --tags
